# shut

> A Bluesky labeller that hides incel language from the people who subscribe to it.

shut applies one label, `incel-language`, to posts and profiles that use listed vocabulary.
It matches words rather than meaning, so it also catches quotes and criticism, and misses
new or coded phrasing. The public instance is @shut.croft.click.

- Source and setup: https://github.com/ewanc26/shut
